$doc: The C9 context-enumeration GRAMMAR (issue #20, constraint C9; design §6.8; ADR dual-instance amendment Decision 1). This file is the committed definition of 'reachable': a (prev, char, next) local context of a C3 single is REACHABLE iff it is licensed by one of the role templates below, closed over the sliver. tools/build_assets.py expands these templates into the machine-readable context table (src/packages/lang-zh/assets/c9-context-table.json) that #19's fail-closed `headset-context-pinned` leg consumes; anything outside the expansion regenerates at runtime BY DESIGN (fail-closed default). Every expanded context is machine-verified by the offline gate (membership + g2pW carrier agreement + segmenter vote + sandhi-consistency + refutation jury) and carries one gold-pass verdict row. Carriers are the g2pW verification sentences: the builder asserts each carrier REALIZES its exact (prev, char, next) context (run boundaries included) before it is used.
$singles: C3 (committed definition, issue #19 step 2(a)): {的, 了, 不, 一} plus the non-heteronymic sentence particles 嗎/呢, admitted as pinned singles. Distinct from the full §6.8 hand-pinned head set (的/地/得, 了, 不, 一, 行, 重, 著, 和) — NOT implemented in v0; head-set singles admitted per C3/C9.
$surfaceRules: 不/一 surface tone shifts are COMPUTED by the builder from the next unit's first base-tone syllable and marked with a rule id, mirroring the deterministic resolver the sidecar re-checks (`_consistency_check` in app/legs/sandhi.py): 不 → bu2 before tone 4 (rule tone-shift-before-4), else bu4; 一 → yi2 before tone 4 (rule tone-shift-before-4), yi4 before tones 1/2/3 (rule tone-shift-before-non-4), yi1 in ordinal/date roles (rule ordinal-date — the hard-coded pattern accepts ONLY entries carrying this marker) and in run-final counting positions.
$hardPatterns: Deliberately NOT enumerable here: any 了 context with prev 不/得 (the V+不/得+了 potential infix — hard-coded regenerate in the sidecar regardless of enumeration), and any 一 ordinal/date context without the ordinal-date rule marker.

templates.role: possessive/attributive particle after a nominal possessor
perfective aspect marker between verb and object
perfective/change-of-state marker after a verb, clause-final
perfective marker after a verb, followed by the question particle
clause-final change-of-state marker after a nominal (吃飯了-class)
templates.carrierNote: the realizing verb is chosen per object (喝茶/喝水/吃飯/看書) so the carrier is idiomatic; the verified context is the 了 trigram, which the verb choice does not touch

templates.role: clause-final change-of-state marker after an adjective
negation before a verb or adjective (surface tone per the next unit's first base tone) — run-initial/adverb-scoped, where elliptical 不+Adj answers are natural

negation after a pronoun subject, before a verb (jury finding, 2026-07 run: pronoun + 不 + bare 多/大 — 我不多/我不大 as full clauses — is unnatural Taiwan Mandarin, so those contexts are deliberately UNREACHABLE: fail-closed regenerate at runtime)
cardinal 一 before a classifier (surface tone per the classifier's base tone)
ordinal/date 一 (weekday) — stays unshifted yī; the hard-coded ordinal pattern accepts ONLY entries carrying this rule
bare counting 一 (its own Han run — counting sequences like 一、二、三)

templates.carrierNote: prev=了/一 realize the closure contexts ((了,嗎,<END>) and (一,嗎,<END>)) that the 了/一 templates with next=嗎 imply — the enumeration is closed under single-adjacency. 你好 is deliberately NOT a prev: its closed-world cover is ambiguous (你好 vs 你|好 — golden fixture 10), so 你好嗎 regenerates at the cover leg before the head-set leg ever consults the table; enumerating it would be dead weight the carrier check cannot even verify. The 他/大/多/今天 carriers carry a topic/copula (是他嗎？ 書大嗎？ — jury finding, 2026-07 run: the bare one-word forms are unnatural as standalone questions; the CONTEXT is unchanged, only the carrier realizes it more naturally)

templates.role: sentence-final topic-shift particle after a nominal (X呢? — and X?)
